Question: As Salaam Alaikum, Before sleeping i recite Surah's Kafiroon,Iqlaas,Falaq,Naas. Aytal Kursi,(3)times all. Lillahi mafissamawate,Surah Muzammil and other dua's and sleep and Alhamdulillah Pray 5 times, but my friends are telling i am weeping in my sleep calling my family.Please tell about this. Jazaak Allah Khair Answer ID: 19407 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 208/208/M=1431) Sometimes it may happen due to some illness, and sometimes it occurs while dreaming unconsciously. You should continue to recite the above-mentioned duas and include durood with it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
